mods.name: ForceSetFlight
mods.description: A specialized movement utility designed to synchronize server-side flight capabilities with client-side physics. By maintaining a persistent flight-state packet, it enables seamless movement and advanced traversal techniques in creative-ready environments by bypassing standard movement simulation constraints.
